units.source_text: 身穿皱巴巴的白裙裤、脚蹬布鞋的朝鲜妇女，

en.t: A Korean woman wearing wrinkled white skirt-pants and cloth shoes,
came walking along with a large bundle on her back,

units.source_text: 里面装着锅碗瓢盆等等用具，把腰都压弯了。

en.t: filled with pots, bowls, ladles, basins, and other utensils, so heavy that it bent her waist.
